```{r}
#| label: q3-1
# Mixed Logit Preparation

library(BLPestimatoR)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)


iri <- read_tsv("~/SchoolWork/Y2S1/IO/PS1/IRI.csv")

iri <- iri %>%
  mutate(
    cdid = str_c("m_", store_id, "_", week_id), # market id
    pid = str_c("p_", brand, "_", store_id, "_", week_id), # product id
    firm_id = parent, # firm id
    share = pmax(quantity / M, 1e-12)
  )

comp_avg <- function(x) {
  n <- length(x)
  s <- sum(x)
  ifelse(n > 1, (s - x) / (n - 1), 0)
}

iri <- iri %>%
  group_by(cdid) %>%
  mutate(
    avg_other_sugars = comp_avg(sugars),
    avg_other_fiber = comp_avg(fiber),
    blp_sugar = (avg_other_sugars - sugars)^2,
    blp_fiber = (avg_other_fiber - fiber)^2
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-avg_other_sugars, -avg_other_fiber)

inc <- read_tsv("~/SchoolWork/Y2S1/IO/PS1/simulated_agents_income.csv")
nchild <- read_tsv("~/SchoolWork/Y2S1/IO/PS1/simulated_agents_nchild.csv")

inc_mean <- inc %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(year, puma), names_to = "draw", values_to = "income") %>%
  group_by(year, puma) %>%
  summarise(
    income = mean(income, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

nchild_mean <- nchild %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(year, puma), names_to = "draw", values_to = "nchild") %>%
  group_by(year, puma) %>%
  summarise(
    nchild = mean(nchild, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

iri <- iri %>%
  left_join(inc_mean, by = c("year", "puma")) %>%
  left_join(nchild_mean, by = c("year", "puma")) %>%
  mutate(
    incsq = income^2,
    fiber_inc = fiber * income,
    sugars_inc = sugars * income,
    fiber_nchild = fiber * nchild,
    sugars_nchild = sugars * nchild
  )

comp_avg <- function(x) {
  n <- length(x)
  s <- sum(x)
  ifelse(n > 1, (s - x) / (n - 1), 0)
}

iri <- iri %>%
  group_by(cdid) %>%
  mutate(
    avg_other_sugars = comp_avg(sugars),
    avg_other_fiber = comp_avg(fiber),
    blp_sugar = (avg_other_sugars - sugars)^2,
    blp_fiber = (avg_other_fiber - fiber)^2
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-avg_other_sugars, -avg_other_fiber)

productData <- iri %>%
  transmute(
    cdid, product_id,
    share = pmax(sj, 1e-12),
    price,
    sugars, fiber, fortified
  )

```
